acceptance: Rebuilt TPC-DS binaries generate the 35-row reason tables at SF1 per the TPC spec
BenchBox SQL reproduces the official Q85 and Q93 answers exactly from the rebuilt data
The weekly SF1 qualification run reports Q85/Q93 as printed-verified
context: Dropped 2026-10-17: the premise is wrong. The 75-row reason table is the official TPC-DS v4.0.0 kit value; the bundled scaling.dst is byte-identical to independent v4.0.0 copies, and 35/45/55 is the v2.x/v3.2 kit. Spec clause 3.4.2: dsdgen prevails. Owner, 2026-10-16, Claude session e0e74e6b, question dialog: "reason 75, restore web_site, stand in" (this voids the earlier "Fix generator and try the rerun" choice). Evidence: attribution docs #3047 5df5466ae; q85/q93 docs note #3060 2b24502cf; row-count checks #3031 876f3dfbe.
description: The bundled TPC-DS generator builds reason tables with 75 rows at every scale factor from _sources/tpc-ds/tools/scaling.dst, while the TPC reference kit expects 35 rows at SF1. Official Q85/Q93 answers therefore never match data generated with the bundled binaries, on any engine. Rebuilding dsdgen/dsqgen with a corrected scaling table and regenerating the reference datasets is a generator change that needs an owner decision.
